name: Tauny
body:
Wilderness areas abound with fey of all sorts. Occasionally, the reclusive and ancient fey females known as glaistigs will seek the company of a faun to share in carnal pleasures. When a pregnancy results from one of these dalliances, a tauny is born.

Physical Description

Taunies are fey, born in the form of a goat.

Upon the sunrise of their 365th day of life, a tauny metamorphosizes into its fully mature adult form (which appears humanoid, but with a few atypical features). Sharing some physical characteristics of its parents, a tauny retains the glaistig’s pupil-less eyes and the faun’s tiny tail. Unique to a tauny are the two bony, knob-like protrusions just above the outer corner of each eyebrow where a faun’s horns would normally be.

Furthermore, a tauny’s legs don’t resemble goat legs like its parents. Instead, a tauny’s legs look like a typical humanoid’s, though its legs do end in hooves rather than feet.

Male taunies have skin tones similar to a faun, whereas the skin tone of a female tauny has a fifty-fifty chance of being either pale green like its mother’s or tanner like its father’s.

Society

On the day of metamorphosis, a tauny gains the ability to speak and reason as a fully mature adult. The metamorphosed tauny is capable of self-care and ready to begin its life independent from its mother.

As a fey, a tauny is predisposed to live in harmony with nature. Most tauny will seek out their father and live amongst the faun community. Some live solitary lives, wandering through the outback and enjoying a close connection with the wilderness. Finally, a few tauny take advantage of their appearance being quite similar to humans or elves, choosing to live in humanoid settlements.

Relations

Taunies can only produce young when mating with other taunies. Therefore, the tauny population is quite small. Most humanoid races live a lifetime without ever meeting or even hearing about a tauny.

Taunies get along perfectly well with good-aligned fey. Concerning humanoid races, taunies make no distinction among them as a whole. A human is as interesting to them as a dwarf or halfling. What taunies do care about is a humanoid’s disposition towards the wilderness. If an individual treats nature’s plants and animals with respect, a tauny will happily engage with the individual. If, on the other hand, an individual is unnecessarily destructive to nature or vindictive towards its inhabitants, a tauny will most definitely seek to distance themselves from such an individual.

Alignment And Religion

Taunies are kind-hearted and free-spirited individuals that most often see the gourd as half full rather than half empty. Most are some combination of good, neutral, or chaotic. Evil-natured taunies are rare. In such cases, a tauny usually becomes jaded by a particularly heinous act they witnessed within the first few months after their metamorphosis.

Taunies revere nature itself or nature deities. A tauny that lives in a humanoid settlement might adopt a prominent deity of that society alongside their devotion to nature.

Adventurers

Taunies live for the day. They enjoy food, drink, dance, song, physical pleasure, and revelry of all sorts. If an adventure lies beyond the horizon or around the bend, a tauny is the first to set off towards it! Taunies gravitate towards vocations as bards, druids, wardens, healers, and seers.

Male Names: Dash, Dasher, Frolik, Kantor, Jovie, Rowan.

Female Names: Autumn, Daisy, Melodie, Summer, Willow.

Core Traits
Ability Score Modifiers: As fit and affable inhabitants of the wilds, taunies rely on their physical prowess and alluring disposition rather than a mind informed by academic studies to achieve success in their daily lives. They gain +2 to Strength and Charisma, but suffer -2 Intelligence.
Type: Taunies are fey.
Size: Medium. Though on the taller end of the spectrum compared to most humans, taunies are Medium creatures and have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.
Speed: Fast. Taunies have a base speed of 40 feet.
Fey Damage Resistance, Lesser: Taunies have DR 1/cold iron.
Iron Stomach: Like a goat, a tauny can digest nearly anything. Taunies gain a +2 racial bonus on all ingested poisons and on saving throws made against eating rotted food. Additionally, once per day, a tauny can cast allfood as a spell-like ability.
Reveler: Taunies are renowned for their celebration of life, particularly through song, dance, and storytelling. Taunies gain a +2 racial bonus on Performance (select any single one of their choice) skill checks.
Goat Guise: A tauny can cast beast shape l as a spell-like ability once per day to turn into a Small goat. Their caster level for this spell is equal to their character level.
Senses: Low-light vision. Taunies can see twice as far as humans in conditions of dim light.
Hooved: Taunies can’t benefit from magical horseshoes because all 4 shoes must be worn to receive the magical benefit. Wearing footwear of any kind (magical or mundane) interferes with a tauny’s movement, reducing their base land speed by 10 feet.
Languages: Taunies begin play speaking Common and Sylvan. Taunies with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following: Elven, Giant, Gnoll, Gnome, Goblin, Orc, and Terran.
Alternate Traits

The following racial traits may be selected instead of the standard racial traits for tauny characters.

Impulsive: Some taunies are so eager to experience life that they leap before they think, failing to consider the ramifications of their actions. These tauny gain a +2 Strength, +2 Charisma, -2 Wisdom to their ability scores. This replaces +2 Strength, +2 Charisma, -2 Intelligence.
Affable: When a tauny uses Diplomacy to shift a creature’s attitude, they can do so up to three steps up rather than just two. In addition, when a tauny successfully uses Diplomacy to win over an individual, that creature takes a -2 penalty on attempts to resist any of the tauny’s Charisma-based skills for the next 24 hours. This replaces reveler.
Natural Armor: Some Taunies don’t possess the damage resistance that most fey have, but instead retain a tougher hide like that of their parents. These fey gain a +1 natural armor bonus to their Armor Class. This replaces fey damage resistance, lesser.
Tauny Magic: The magical nature of a tauny manifests differently for each individual. Rather than shapechanging into a goat, some taunies gain a +1 racial bonus to the DC of any saving throws of spells they cast with the emotion descriptor. Furthermore, a tauny with a Charisma score of 11 or higher gains the following spell-like abilities usable once per day each: create water, purify food and drink, know direction. The tauny’s caster level for these spells is equal to the tauny’s character level. The DC for these spell-like abilities is equal to 10 + the tauny’s Charisma modifier. This replaces goat guise.
Terrabond (Ex) Some taunies are more strongly influenced by their mother’s special connection to the land. Whenever a tauny is not inside a man-made structure, the tauny gains a +1 racial bonus on their CMD against bull rush, reposition, and trip maneuvers that attempt to move them against their will. They also gain this bonus on saving throws made against any effects that would knock them prone. This replaces iron stomach.

Into the Wilds: The Tauny, Copyright 2024, Bloodstone Press; author Beth Jones
